escena: SCENE (customer support floor at night, Santiago, almost completely dark): the ONE light in the whole picture is a single monitor at her station that has JUST LIT UP, in the lower right third of the frame. Its glowing cool blue screen shows ONE chat conversation as a column of rounded message bubbles, and the newest bubble at the bottom glows noticeably brighter than all the others: the conversation has just been handed to her. Nexa, in a navy piqué polo, is caught at the instant she turns out of the dark towards that screen in three-quarter view, lifting a slim headset microphone to her ear with one hand, lips just parted as she is about to answer. The screen light falls on the near side of her face, her hand and her chest; the far side of her face drops into darkness. Behind her the rest of the floor is dark, empty stations barely readable as shapes. The orange sculpture stands on the desk right beside the monitor, clearly visible and a real presence in the picture — about as tall as the monitor's stand, its matte enamel lit by the screen glow. Very high contrast. 50mm lens at f/2, focus on her eyes. The whole frame is COOL and contemporary: daylight-neutral white balance, blue-leaning shadows, nothing warm, amber, golden or tungsten anywhere, no retro glow — the ONLY warm colour in the entire picture is the small orange sculpture itself. The sculpture's ring-and-nodes symbol belongs ONLY to the sculpture: it never appears on her clothing. Everything except the sculpture and the polo is completely unbranded and no text is readable: the bubbles read as shapes, never as words. CRITICAL FRAMING (square 1:1): the ACTION AREA is the lower 58% of the frame. The TOP 42% of the frame is one single dark, evenly toned surface with NOTHING in it: no object, no screen, no lamp, no window, no light beam, no bright spot, no shadow edge. If a person is in the picture, the top of her head is no higher than 42% down from the top edge. All action, all light and every bright patch stay inside the action area. REFRAMING (essential): the camera is further back, so she is framed SMALLER and LOWER in the square: the top of her head sits at the MIDDLE of the frame, 50% down from the top edge, and the whole upper half above her is dark and empty.
